name: no-redundancy-cwm-sol
description: Verifies the device has no redundancy nodes. It checks that there are active nodes present. If the validation fails then the status would be returned as "failed", else it would be "success".

definition.name: no-redundancy-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or  (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

data.template:
Value NODE (\S+)
Value TYPE (\S+)
Value STATE ([\w\s]+)
Value CONFIG_STATE (\S+)

Start
  ^Node -> PLATFORMS

PLATFORMS
  ^${NODE}\s+${TYPE}\s+${STATE}\s+${CONFIG_STATE}* -> Record

expressions.condition: ((. | length > 0) and ( map(select(.TYPE | test("(\\Active\\)")) | select(.CONFIG_STATE == "NSHUT")) | length == 1 ) and ( map(select(.TYPE | test("(\\Standby\\)")) | select(.CONFIG_STATE == "NSHUT")) | length == 1 ) or ( map(select(.TYPE | test("(\\Standby\\)"))) | length == 0 ))

logs.message: Forming inputs for redundancy check for XR devices

data.template:
Value SLOT (..)
Value TYPE (\S+)
Value STATE (\S+\s?\S+)
Value INSERT_TIME (\S+)

Start
 ^${SLOT}(\s{8})+${TYPE}\s+${STATE}\s+${INSERT_TIME}* -> Record

expressions.message: One or more standby node found.

logs.message: Forming inputs for redundancy check for XE devices

dataConditions.name: success condition
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: failure condition
dataConditions.condition: ${ if (.rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" and .rakutilExecutorData.stash != null) then true else false end}

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: (if .rakutilExecutorData.message then ("One or more standby node found" + .rakutilExecutorData.message) else "One or more standby node found" end), stash: .rakutilExecutorData.nsoResponse }}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

definition.description: Verifies the device has no redundancy nodes. It checks that there are active nodes present. If the validation fails then the status would be returned as "failed", else it would be "success".
